Activities Description: Drive to Chidambaram. Hotel check-in. Visit the world-famous Thillai Nataraja Temple, covered with a gold-plated roof (Ponnambalam). Experience the mystic Chidambara Rahasyam (secret of space), the Ruby Nataraja crystal lingam abhishekam, and Govindaraja Perumal Divya Desam inside the same complex.

Package Name: Chidambaram Nataraja Temple & Pichavaram Mangrove Tour
Route Segment: Chidambaram to Pichavaram and Return (40 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Pichavaram Mangrove Canals, Thillai Kali Temple
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Pichavaram Mangrove Boat Cruise
Evening / Night Activity: Return departure
Activities Description: Morning visit to Pichavaram, the second largest mangrove forest in the world. 2-hour rowboat cruise through narrow shaded water canals under lush mangrove canopies. Visit Thillai Kali Temple. Afternoon return journey to Chennai / Trichy.

Package Name: Kumbakonam Navagraha 9 Cosmic Planets Temples Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Thingalur Chandran Temple, Alangudi Guru Temple, Thirunageswaram Rahu Temple
Morning Activity: Arrival, check-in, visit Thingalur and Alangudi
Evening / Night Activity: Thirunageswaram milk abhishekam, dinner
Activities Description: Arrival in Kumbakonam, check-in. Visit 1. Thingalur Kailasanathar Temple (Moon / Chandran), 2. Alangudi Apatsahayeswarar Temple (Jupiter / Guru), and 3. Thirunageswaram Naganathar Temple (Rahu) where milk turns blue during abhishekam. Pure veg dinner.

Package Name: Kumbakonam Navagraha 9 Cosmic Planets Temples Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Suryanar Kovil, Kanjanur Sukran Temple, Vaitheeswaran Koil, Thiruvenkadu
Morning Activity: Visit Suryanar Kovil and Kanjanur
Evening / Night Activity: Vaitheeswaran Koil evening pooja, dinner
Activities Description: Full day visiting 4. Suryanar Kovil (Sun / Suriyan), 5. Kanjanur Agneeswarar Temple (Venus / Sukran), 6. Vaitheeswaran Koil (Mars / Sevvai & Lord of Healing), and 7. Thiruvenkadu Swetharanyeswarar Temple (Mercury / Budhan). Traditional lunch enroute.

Package Name: Kumbakonam Navagraha 9 Cosmic Planets Temples Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Keezhperumpallam, Thirunallar Saneeswarar Temple, Nala Theertham
Morning Activity: Keezhperumpallam Ketu temple and Thirunallar Sani temple
Evening / Night Activity: Departure with total peace and planetary blessings
Activities Description: Visit 8. Keezhperumpallam Naganathar Temple (Ketu) and 9. Thirunallar Darbaranyeswarar Temple (Saturn / Sani) in Karaikal with holy dip in Nala Theertham and sesame oil lamp offering. Complete Navagraha parihara rituals. Return journey to Chennai / Trichy.

Package Name: Thanjavur Brihadeeswarar Big Temple & Nayak Palace Heritage Tour
Day Title: Arrival Thanjavur & UNESCO Big Temple Exploration
Sightseeing Spots: Brihadeeswarar Big Temple, Monolithic Nandi, Chola Murals, Temple Tank
Morning Activity: Arrival, check-in, lunch
Evening / Night Activity: Temple illumination photography, dinner
Activities Description: Arrival in Thanjavur, hotel check-in and lunch. Afternoon guided exploration of the UNESCO World Heritage Brihadeeswarar Temple (Peruvudaiyar Kovil) built by Raja Raja Chola I. Admire the colossal monolithic Nandi and vimanam shadow that never touches the ground at noon. Evening temple illumination and pooja.

Package Name: Thanjavur Brihadeeswarar Big Temple & Nayak Palace Heritage Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Thanjavur Royal Palace, Bronze Gallery, Saraswathi Mahal Library, Tanjore Doll workshops
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Royal Palace and Art Gallery visit
Evening / Night Activity: Departure transfer
Activities Description: Visit Thanjavur Maratha Royal Palace complex, Schwartz Church, and Saraswathi Mahal Library housing palm-leaf manuscripts. Visit Tanjore art plate and glass painting workshops. Afternoon departure transfer to Trichy Junction / Airport.

Package Name: Tiruchirappalli Srirangam Ranganathaswamy & Rockfort Tour
Day Title: Arrival Trichy & Srirangam Mega Temple Complex
Route Segment: Trichy City & Srirangam Island (30 km circuit)
Sightseeing Spots: Srirangam Temple, 21 Gopurams, Hall of 1000 Pillars, Thiruvanaikaval Water Stalam
Morning Activity: Arrival, check-in, lunch
Evening / Night Activity: Srirangam temple bazaar walk, dinner
Activities Description: Arrival in Trichy, hotel check-in. Cross Cauvery bridge to Srirangam island. Guided tour of Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple with 21 grand gopurams, 7 concentric enclosures (prakarams), and the 73-meter Raja Gopuram. Darshan of Lord Ranganatha in reclining posture (Sayana kolam). Evening visit to Thiruvanaikaval Jambukeswarar Temple (Pancha Bhoota Water Stalam with underground perennial spring).

Package Name: Tiruchirappalli Srirangam Ranganathaswamy & Rockfort Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Rockfort Temple, Thayumanaswamy Sannidhi, Cauvery Riverview
Morning Activity: Rockfort climb and Ucchi Pillayar darshan, breakfast
Evening / Night Activity: Departure transfer
Activities Description: Morning climb of the 437 cut-stone steps of the 83-meter high Rockfort to reach Ucchi Pillayar Temple, offering 360-degree views of Cauvery river and Srirangam. Visit Thayumanaswamy Shiva temple midway. Traditional lunch. Departure transfer to Trichy Airport / Junction.

Package Name: Tiruvannamalai Arunachaleswarar Agni Temple & Girivalam Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Arunachaleswarar Temple, Agni Lingam, Thousand Pillar Hall, Patala Lingam
Morning Activity: 07:00 AM pickup, scenic rural drive, arrival by 11:30 AM
Evening / Night Activity: Grand evening deeparadhana, pure vegetarian dinner
Activities Description: Morning 07:00 AM departure from Chennai. Arrive in holy town Tiruvannamalai. Check-in to hotel, lunch. Darshan at the ancient 10-hectare Arunachaleswarar Temple, one of India’s largest temples. Worship the holy Agni Lingam and Goddess Unnamalai Amman. Visit the 1,000-pillar hall and Patala Lingam where Sri Ramana Maharshi meditated. Attend the grand evening deeparadhana.

Package Name: Tiruvannamalai Arunachaleswarar Agni Temple & Girivalam Tour
Day Title: Sacred 14-km Girivalam & Ramana Ashram to Chennai
Sightseeing Spots: Ashtalingams, Ramana Maharshi Ashram, Skandashram, Virupaksha Cave view
Morning Activity: Early morning Girivalam and Ashtalingam worship, breakfast
Evening / Night Activity: Return drive to Chennai, drop at residence
Activities Description: Early morning sacred Girivalam (14-km circumambulation of Arunachala Hill) covering the 8 Ashtalingam temples: Indra, Agni, Yama, Niruthi, Varuna, Vayu, Kubera, and Esanya Lingam. Breakfast. Visit Sri Ramana Maharshi Ashram and meditate in the Samadhi hall. Check out and drive back to Chennai arriving by 08:30 PM.

Package Name: Srivilliputhur Andal Nachiyar Temple & Southern Divya Desams Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Srivilliputhur Andal Temple, 11-Tier Rajagopuram, Vadapathrasayee Temple
Morning Activity: Pickup from Madurai, drive to Srivilliputhur
Evening / Night Activity: Andal evening archana, palkova tasting, dinner
Activities Description: Pickup from Madurai. Drive to Srivilliputhur. Hotel check-in. Darshan at the twin temple complex: Sri Andal Temple and Vadapathrasayee Temple. Marvel at the 192-foot Rajagopuram, the flower garden where Periyalwar discovered baby Andal, and the Nandavanam. Taste famous warm milk sweet Srivilliputhur Palkova.

Package Name: Srivilliputhur Andal Nachiyar Temple & Southern Divya Desams Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Tenkasi Kasi Viswanathar Temple, Courtallam Main Falls, Five Falls
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Tenkasi Kasi Viswanathar Temple
Evening / Night Activity: Herbal waterfalls bath, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Tenkasi. Darshan at the 700-year-old Kasi Viswanathar Temple with its soaring 180-foot gopuram. Proceed to Courtallam (Spa of South India) for rejuvenating herbal bath in the natural waterfalls: Main Falls and Five Falls. Return to hotel.

Package Name: Srivilliputhur Andal Nachiyar Temple & Southern Divya Desams Tour
Route Segment: Tenkasi to Sankaran Kovil to Madurai (130 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Sankaranarayanaswamy Temple, Gomathi Amman Sannidhi
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Sankaran Kovil temple darshan
Evening / Night Activity: Drop at Madurai Junction / Airport
Activities Description: Visit the sacred Sankaran Kovil Sri Sankaranarayanaswamy Temple where Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu are enshrined as a single composite deity (Sankara-Narayana). Traditional lunch. Return drive to Madurai for departure.

Package Name: Sirkazhi Sattainathar & Vaitheeswaran Koil Sevvai Temple Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Sirkazhi Sattainathar 3-Tier Temple, Sambandar Sannidhi
Morning Activity: Arrival, hotel check-in, lunch
Evening / Night Activity: Sattainathar midnight Friday pooja view / evening aarti, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Sirkazhi. Hotel check-in and lunch. Visit the monumental Brahmapureeswarar / Sattainathar Temple featuring Lord Shiva in 3 divine levels: Brahmapureeswarar on ground, Periyanayakar with Uma in middle, and Sattainathar at top tier. Visit Tirumullaivayil and Kazhumalam sacred tanks. Evening deeparadhana.

Package Name: Sirkazhi Sattainathar & Vaitheeswaran Koil Sevvai Temple Tour
Route Segment: Sirkazhi to Vaitheeswaran to Chennai (250 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Vaitheeswaran Koil, Angaragan Sannidhi, Siddhamirtham Tank
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Vaitheeswaran Koil darshan and parihara pooja
Evening / Night Activity: Return journey to Chennai arriving by 08:30 PM
Activities Description: Morning visit to Vaitheeswaran Koil. Dip in sacred Siddhamirtham tank. Worship Lord Vaidyanathar (divine physician curing all ailments), Goddess Thaiyalnayaki, Lord Angaragan (Mars), and Lord Muthukumara Swamy. Receive sacred medicine ball (Tiruchandu Urundai). Lunch. Return journey to Chennai.

Package Name: Sabarimala Lord Ayyappa Swamy Sacred Pilgrimage Tour
Day Title: Madurai to Nilakkal & Pamba Base Camp
Route Segment: Madurai to Theni to Pamba (240 km / 6 hrs)
Sightseeing Spots: Western Ghats, Pamba River, Pamba Ganapathi Temple
Morning Activity: Departure from Madurai, scenic mountain ghats drive
Evening / Night Activity: Pamba evening bhajans, rest and refreshment
Activities Description: Departure by deluxe coach through scenic Western Ghats past Kumily and Gavi forests. Arrive at Nilakkal base camp, transfer by KSRTC chain bus to sacred Pamba. Hotel check-in / pilgrim rest house. Holy bath in Pamba river, Pamba Ganapathi temple darshan, preparation of Irumudi kettu.

Package Name: Sabarimala Lord Ayyappa Swamy Sacred Pilgrimage Tour
Route Segment: Pamba to Sannidhanam Trek (5 km uphill)
Sightseeing Spots: Pathinettampadi, Lord Ayyappa Sannidhanam, Malikappurathamma, Vavar Nada
Morning Activity: Neelimala trek, 18 Holy Steps ascent, Ayyappa Darshan
Evening / Night Activity: Descend to Pamba, transfer to Nilakkal, dinner
Activities Description: Early morning trek up the holy Neelimala and Appachimedu with chantings of Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa. Arrive at Sannidhanam. Ascend the sacred 18 gold-plated steps (Pathinettam Padi) with Irumudi. Golden Darshan of Lord Dharma Sastha / Ayyappa Swamy. Neyyabhishekam offering. Receive Appam and Aravana prasadam. Worship Malikappurathamma. Evening descend back to Pamba.

Package Name: Sabarimala Lord Ayyappa Swamy Sacred Pilgrimage Tour
Route Segment: Nilakkal to Erumeli to Madurai / Cochin (200 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Erumeli Sastha Temple, Vavar Mosque, Western Ghats vistas
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Erumeli temple darshan
Evening / Night Activity: Departure transfer with blessings
Activities Description: Visit Erumeli Sri Dharma Sastha temple and Vavar mosque. Visit Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple if departing via Cochin or return via Kumily to Madurai. Transfer to airport / railway station with divine grace of Lord Ayyappa.

Package Name: Marudhamalai Murugan & Perur Pateeswarar Temple Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Marudhamalai Hill Temple, Pambatti Siddhar Cave, Herbal Springs
Morning Activity: Arrival, check-in, lunch
Evening / Night Activity: Evening deeparadhana, Coimbatore market walk, dinner
Activities Description: Arrival in Coimbatore. Hotel check-in and lunch. Drive to Marudhamalai (Hill of Marutham trees). Ascent by temple bus / car to the hilltop sanctuary of Lord Subramanya Swamy (Dhandayuthapani). Visit Pambatti Siddhar Cave where the revered snake-charmer saint attained samadhi. Evening golden chariot / aarti.

Package Name: Marudhamalai Murugan & Perur Pateeswarar Temple Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Perur Pateeswarar Temple, Kanaka Sabha, Eachanari Vinayagar
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Perur Pateeswarar and Eachanari Vinayagar darshan
Evening / Night Activity: Departure transfer
Activities Description: Morning visit to the 1,500-year-old Perur Pateeswarar Temple on the banks of Noyyal River. Marvel at the Kanaka Sabha with stone pillars of Nataraja dancing. Visit Eachanari Vinayagar Temple with its 6-foot monolithic Ganesha. Traditional Kongu lunch. Departure transfer to Coimbatore Airport / Railway Junction.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Marina Beach, Santhome Basilica
Morning Activity: Pickup from airport/railway station, hotel check-in
Evening / Night Activity: Mylapore market walk, dinner
Activities Description: Arrival in Chennai, traditional welcome and transfer to hotel. Visit Kapaleeshwarar Temple Mylapore, Gandhi Memorial, Kalakshetra, and Marina Beach.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, Tiruchanur Padmavathi Temple
Morning Activity: Early departure, breakfast enroute
Evening / Night Activity: Return to hotel, dinner
Activities Description: Early departure to Tirumala Hills for Lord Venkateswara Balaji Special Entry Darshan. Visit Padmavathi Ammavari Temple. Return to hotel.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Route Segment: Chennai to Kanchipuram to Mamallapuram (120 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Ekambareswarar, Kamakshi Amman, Shore Temple, Five Rathas
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Kanchipuram temple darshan
Evening / Night Activity: Sunset at beach, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Kanchipuram. Darshan at Ekambareswarar, Kamakshi Amman, and Varadharaja Perumal. Continue to Mamallapuram for Shore Temple and Arjuna Penance.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Arunachaleswarar Temple, Ramana Maharshi Ashram, Pondicherry Beach
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Tiruvannamalai
Evening / Night Activity: Check-in at Pondicherry hotel, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to sacred Arunachala hill town Tiruvannamalai. Darshan at Arunachaleswarar Temple (Agni Stalam). Proceed to Pondicherry.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Sri Aurobindo Ashram, Auroville, Manakula Vinayagar Temple
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Auroville and Ashram visit
Evening / Night Activity: Promenade walk, cafe dinner
Activities Description: Visit Sri Aurobindo Ashram, Auroville Matrimandir, French colonial quarters, and Manakula Vinayagar Temple. Leisure evening on Promenade.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Route Segment: Pondicherry to Chidambaram to Thanjavur (175 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Chidambaram Nataraja Temple, Thanjavur Brihadeeswarar Temple
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Chidambaram Nataraja Temple darshan
Evening / Night Activity: Thanjavur Royal Palace, dinner
Activities Description: Visit Chidambaram Nataraja Temple (Akasha Stalam). Drive to Thanjavur. Darshan at the 1,000-year-old Brihadeeswarar Big Temple.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Srirangam Temple, Jambukeswarar Water Stalam, Rockfort Temple
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Srirangam
Evening / Night Activity: Cauvery river walk, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Trichy. Darshan at Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple Srirangam (1st Divya Desam) and Ucchi Pillayar Rockfort Temple.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal, Gandhi Memorial Museum
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Madurai
Evening / Night Activity: Meenakshi Amman Temple special evening darshan
Activities Description: Drive to Madurai. Check-in. Evening visit to Sri Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple for evening pooja and silver palanquin procession.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Pamban Bridge, Ramanathaswamy Temple 22 Wells, Dhanushkodi, Ram Setu
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive across Pamban Sea Bridge
Evening / Night Activity: Temple corridor walk, overnight in Rameswaram
Activities Description: Cross Pamban Bridge to Rameswaram. Holy bath at Agni Theertham and 22 temple well theerthams. Spatika Lingam darshan. Visit Dhanushkodi and Ram Setu.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Kumari Amman Temple, Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Thiruvalluvar Statue
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Kanyakumari
Evening / Night Activity: Sunset view at Triveni Sangam, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Kanyakumari. Visit Kumari Amman Temple, Vivekananda Rock Memorial by ferry, and Thiruvalluvar Statue. Sunset at Triveni Sangam.

Package Name: Grand South India 11-Day Temple Pilgrimage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Kovalam Beach, Napier Museum
Morning Activity: Ocean sunrise view, breakfast, drive to Trivandrum
Evening / Night Activity: Departure with immense blessings
Activities Description: Sunrise over ocean. Drive to Trivandrum. Darshan at Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple. Transfer to Trivandrum Airport / Railway Station for departure.

Package Name: Athirappilly, Munnar & Thekkady Hills & Waterfalls Tour
Day Title: Arrival Cochin - Athirappilly Falls - Munnar Transfer
Route Segment: Cochin to Athirappilly to Munnar (170 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Athirappilly Waterfalls, Vazhachal Forest, Cheeyappara Falls
Morning Activity: Pickup from Cochin, Athirappilly Falls visit
Evening / Night Activity: Munnar hotel check-in, campfire, dinner
Activities Description: Pickup from Cochin. Drive to the majestic 80-foot Athirappilly Waterfalls. Enjoy spray walk and forest viewpoints. Ascend through Neriamangalam bridge and Cheeyappara falls to Munnar. Hotel check-in, dinner.

Package Name: Athirappilly, Munnar & Thekkady Hills & Waterfalls Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Lake, Echo Point, Tata Tea Museum
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Mattupetty boating and Eco Point
Evening / Night Activity: Resort leisure, dinner
Activities Description: Full day in Munnar visiting Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Lake, Eco Point, Top Station viewpoints, and Tata Tea Museum. Tea tasting and shopping.

Package Name: Athirappilly, Munnar & Thekkady Hills & Waterfalls Tour
Route Segment: Munnar to Thekkady to Cochin (190 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Periyar Tiger Reserve, Spice Plantations
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Periyar Lake wildlife boating
Evening / Night Activity: Drop at Cochin Airport / Railway Station
Activities Description: Morning drive to Thekkady. Boat safari in Periyar Lake spotting wild elephants, bisons, and birds. Spice plantation walk. Evening drive back to Cochin for departure.

Package Name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty Royal Heritage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Lalbagh, Vidhana Soudha, Cubbon Park, ISKCON Temple
Morning Activity: Pickup, hotel check-in
Evening / Night Activity: MG Road / Brigade Road stroll, dinner
Activities Description: Pickup from Bangalore. Visit Lalbagh Botanical Garden with glass house, Vidhana Soudha, Cubbon Park, and ISKCON Temple. Overnight in Bangalore.

Package Name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty Royal Heritage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Srirangapatna, Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hills, Brindavan Gardens
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Mysore via Srirangapatna
Evening / Night Activity: Brindavan Gardens musical fountain, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Mysore. Stop at Tipu Sultan summer palace in Srirangapatna. Arrive Mysore, visit Mysore Royal Palace and Brindavan Gardens musical fountain.

Package Name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty Royal Heritage Circuit
Day Title: Mysore Zoo to Ooty Nilgiri Hills Transfer
Route Segment: Mysore to Ooty via Bandipur (125 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Mysore Zoo, Bandipur Forest, Kalhatty Ghats
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Mysore Zoo visit, jungle safari drive
Evening / Night Activity: Arrive Ooty, hotel check-in, campfire, dinner
Activities Description: Morning visit to Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens. Drive through Bandipur and Mudumalai tiger reserves. Ascend 36 hairpin bends to Ooty.

Package Name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty Royal Heritage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Doddabetta Peak, Botanical Garden, Rose Garden, Ooty Lake
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Doddabetta Peak panoramic view
Evening / Night Activity: Boating, chocolate shopping, dinner
Activities Description: Visit Doddabetta Peak (highest in South India), Ooty Botanical Garden, Rose Garden, and boat ride in Ooty Lake. Homemade chocolate shopping.

Package Name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty Royal Heritage Circuit
Day Title: Coonoor Tea Gardens & Sim’s Park Excursion
Route Segment: Ooty to Coonoor and Return (40 km)
Sightseeing Spots: Toy Train, Sim’s Park, Dolphin’s Nose, Lamb’s Rock, Tea Factory
Morning Activity: Nilgiri Mountain Railway Toy Train ride to Coonoor
Evening / Night Activity: Return to Ooty, resort dinner
Activities Description: Excursion to Coonoor by Toy Train or car. Visit Sim’s Park, Dolphin’s Nose viewpoint, Lamb’s Rock, and Highfield Tea Factory.

Package Name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty Royal Heritage Circuit
Sightseeing Spots: Pykara Lake, Pykara Falls, Shooting Spot Pine Forests
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Pykara Lake speedboating
Evening / Night Activity: Drop at Coimbatore Airport / Railway Station
Activities Description: Visit Pykara Lake and Pykara Waterfalls with speedboating. Descend the Nilgiri hills to Coimbatore Airport / Railway Junction for departure.

Package Name: Bangalore & Mysore Royal Heritage Getaway
Sightseeing Spots: Lalbagh, Bangalore Palace, Cubbon Park
Morning Activity: Pickup, city tour
Evening / Night Activity: Dinner at hotel
Activities Description: Pickup from Bangalore. Visit Lalbagh, Cubbon Park, Vidhana Soudha, and Bangalore Palace. Check-in, dinner.

Package Name: Bangalore & Mysore Royal Heritage Getaway
Sightseeing Spots: Srirangapatna, Mysore Palace, Brindavan Gardens
Morning Activity: Breakfast, drive to Mysore
Evening / Night Activity: Musical fountain, dinner
Activities Description: Drive to Mysore. Visit Tipu Sultan fort Srirangapatna, Mysore Palace, and Brindavan Gardens illumination.

Package Name: Bangalore & Mysore Royal Heritage Getaway
Sightseeing Spots: Chamundi Hills, Monolithic Nandi, Mysore Zoo
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Chamundi Hills visit
Evening / Night Activity: Drop at Bangalore Airport / Railway Station
Activities Description: Visit Chamundeshwari Temple atop Chamundi Hills, Nandi monolith, and Mysore Zoo. Drive back to Bangalore for departure.

Package Name: Malabar Coast Beaches & Historical Bekal Fort Tour
Sightseeing Spots: Kappad Beach, Sargaalaya Arts Village, Muzhappilangad Drive-in Beach
Morning Activity: Arrival Calicut, Kappad Beach and Sargaalaya
Evening / Night Activity: Sunset drive on beach sands, dinner
Activities Description: Arrival in Calicut. Visit historic Kappad Beach (Vasco da Gama landing site 1498) and Sargaalaya Arts Village. Proceed to Kannur. Experience Muzhappilangad Drive-in Beach (Asia’s longest drive-in beach). Hotel check-in, Malabar seafood dinner.

Package Name: Malabar Coast Beaches & Historical Bekal Fort Tour
Route Segment: Kannur to Bekal to Kasaragod (85 km)
Sightseeing Spots: St. Angelo Fort, Bekal Fort, Bekal Beach Park, Chandragiri River
Morning Activity: Breakfast, St. Angelo Fort and drive to Bekal
Evening / Night Activity: Departure transfer at Kasaragod / Mangalore
Activities Description: Morning visit to St. Angelo Fort in Kannur. Drive to Kasaragod to explore the keyhole-shaped Bekal Fort jutting into the Arabian Sea (famous from movie Bombay). Visit Bekal Beach Park and Chandragiri Fort. Departure transfer.

Package Name: Coorg & Wayanad Coffee Hills & Mist Holiday
Day Title: Arrival Mysore to Coorg - Abbey Falls & Raja Seat
Sightseeing Spots: Abbey Falls, Omkareshwara Temple, Raja’s Seat
Morning Activity: Pickup from Mysore, coffee trail drive
Evening / Night Activity: Resort campfire, Coorg traditional pork/veg dinner
Activities Description: Pickup from Mysore. Scenic drive through sandalwood and coffee territory into Madikeri, Coorg. Check-in to resort, lunch. Visit Abbey Falls cascading amidst coffee plantations, Omkareshwara Temple, and Raja’s Seat for sunset over rolling Western Ghats.

Package Name: Coorg & Wayanad Coffee Hills & Mist Holiday
Route Segment: Coorg to Wayanad via Kutta (110 km / 3 hrs)
Sightseeing Spots: Talacauvery, Bhagamandala, Banasura Sagar Dam
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Talacauvery and Bhagamandala
Evening / Night Activity: Check-in to Wayanad resort, musical evening, dinner
Activities Description: Morning visit to Talacauvery (birthplace of River Kaveri) and Bhagamandala. Drive across Kerala border into Wayanad. Visit Banasura Sagar Dam (largest earthen dam in India) with speedboating.

Package Name: Coorg & Wayanad Coffee Hills & Mist Holiday
Day Title: Edakkal Caves, Soochipara Falls & Calicut Drop
Sightseeing Spots: Edakkal Caves, Soochipara Falls, Lakkidi Viewpoint
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Edakkal Caves prehistoric petroglyphs trek
Evening / Night Activity: Drop at Calicut Airport / Railway Station
Activities Description: Morning trek to prehistoric Neolithic rock carvings at Edakkal Caves. Visit Soochipara Waterfalls. Drive down Thamarassery Churam mountain pass with 9 hairpin bends to Calicut for departure.

Package Name: Goa Sun, Sand & Portuguese Heritage Holiday
Sightseeing Spots: Private beach access, palm groves
Morning Activity: Pickup and resort check-in
Evening / Night Activity: Beach sunset, Goan seafood dinner
Activities Description: Pickup from railway station / airport. Transfer to beach resort, check-in. Lunch. Afternoon at leisure enjoying beach walks or pool. Sunset beach stroll and welcome dinner.

Package Name: Goa Sun, Sand & Portuguese Heritage Holiday
Day Title: North Goa Forts, Beaches & Water Sports
Sightseeing Spots: Fort Aguada, Calangute, Baga, Anjuna, Vagator Beach
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Fort Aguada visit
Evening / Night Activity: Night market / beach shack dining
Activities Description: Explore 17th-century Portuguese Fort Aguada and lighthouse. Visit Calangute Beach, Baga Beach, Anjuna Beach, and Vagator red cliff beach. Water sports options (parasailing, jet ski). Evening Tito’s Lane nightlife stroll.

Package Name: Goa Sun, Sand & Portuguese Heritage Holiday
Day Title: Old Goa UNESCO Heritage & Mandovi Sunset Cruise
Sightseeing Spots: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, Fontainhas Latin Quarter, Mandovi Cruise
Morning Activity: Breakfast, Old Goa heritage churches
Evening / Night Activity: Mandovi River Sunset Cruise, gala dinner
Activities Description: Visit Basilica of Bom Jesus (storing mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier), Se Cathedral, and Church of St. Francis of Assisi. Walk through Fontainhas Latin Quarter in Panaji. Evening 1-hour sunset cruise on Mandovi River with Goan folk music and dance.

Sightseeing Spots: Local Goan craft market
